subject: Skylabs: impact narrative + quote — QA and signoff
messages:

Subject: Skylabs: impact narrative + quote — first draft for your review

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for taking the time last week. Attached is a first draft of the short customer narrative we discussed plus the proposed quote language and a one-paragraph telecom-style blurb for your website. High level asks: could you please

- Fact-check the product usage numbers (we have "average inference latency reduced by 38%" and "monthly token spend down 27%")
- Confirm the customer-facing quote attributed to Alex (we've drafted a short pull-quote)
- Note any editorial redlines or brand compliance needs

Attachments: skylabs-impact-draft-v1.docx (case narrative + proposed quote + 1-pg summary)

Timeline: If possible, a quick pass by Tue 11/30 would let us fold changes into the final asset and route the quote for signoff. If you'd rather we jump on a 20-minute call to walk the edits, happy to schedule.

Thanks — and please flag anything that feels off.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Senior Customer Marketing Manager
Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0192

From: Samantha Cho <samantha.cho@skylabs.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@skylabs.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Skylabs: impact narrative + quote — first draft for your review

Naomi —

Thanks for sending this over. Alex and I reviewed and attached our redlines (redlines_skylabs-impact-v2.docx). A few quick notes inline here:

- The "38% latency reduction" is close but our internal metric uses median p95 across our production traffic; we typically report "~35% p95 latency improvement". Would you mind switching to that phrasing?
- The cost number is accurate but the comparison year should be 2025 vs 2026 (you have 2024 listed) — please update the baseline year.
- For the pull-quote attributed to Alex, he prefers the version in the doc (shorter).

We also flagged two brand compliance items: our legal asks that the Skylabs logo placement be previewed and that the quote be approved by Alex sign-off. I'm OK to do a quick call Thursday morning if you want to walk through the redlines.

Attaching: redlines_skylabs-impact-v2.docx (inline comments + tracked changes)

Best,
Samantha Cho
Head of Product Marketing
Skylabs AI
samantha.cho@skylabs.ai

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Samantha Cho <samantha.cho@skylabs.ai>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 08:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Skylabs: impact narrative + quote — first draft for your review

Naomi / team —

I looked through Samantha's redlines. Two small technical clarifications I recommend we offer back to keep the language accurate but still concise:

1) Latency: change "38%" to "~35% p95 latency improvement" as they requested. I'll add a parenthetical note: "measured on Skylabs production workloads (p95)."
2) Cost comparison: update baseline year to 2025 and make the phrasing "reduced monthly inference spend by 27% (2025 → 2026)".

Proposed customer quote (shortened for marketing):
"Redwood's runtime cut our inference latency and cost, letting us iterate on model improvements faster." — Alex Rivera, VP Engineering, Skylabs AI

Evelyn — can you confirm the logo usage guidance and whether we need our own brand-safe placement doc in the asset folder?

Marcus
Senior Customer Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Cho <samantha.cho@skylabs.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 11:41:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Skylabs: impact narrative + quote — consolidated changes and next steps

Samantha —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the redlines. Summary of edits we've incorporated into the updated draft: 

- Latency phrasing changed to "~35% p95 latency improvement (measured on Skylabs production workloads)"
- Cost comparison updated to "27% reduction in monthly inference spend (2025 → 2026)"
- Pull-quote replaced with Alex's preferred wording (see below)
- Logo placement: Evelyn will share a brand-safe placement guideline in the Drive folder 

Quote for approval (final pull-quote we plan to use):
"Redwood's runtime cut our inference latency and cost, letting us iterate on model improvements faster." — Alex Rivera, VP Engineering, Skylabs AI

I uploaded the consolidated files and a short change log to our shared Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Skylabs-Drive-CaseStudy (consolidated_change_log.txt summarizes the redlines).

Next steps:
- If Alex is good with the quote, we'll route the one-line quote to DocuSign for formal signoff on the usage and permission to publish.
- I'll also attach a preview of the webpage layout for logo placement once Evelyn confirms.

If it's helpful, I'm available for a 15-minute call Mon 11/30 at 10am PT to finalize. Otherwise, please respond with a quick approval and we'll send the DocuSign.

Thanks again — excited to get this published.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Senior Customer Marketing Manager
Redwood Inference

Naomi —

Thanks — Alex reviewed and is fine with the pull-quote as written. We've completed internal legal review and Alex has signed the short quote permission via PDF (attached). Two tiny copy nits he asked to keep as edits: change "iterate on model improvements faster" → "iterate on models faster" (makes it snappier), and remove the word "cut" from the front of the sentence so it starts "Redwood's runtime reduced our inference latency and cost..."

Attached: signed_skylabs_quote_3694.pdf

Once you incorporate those two micro-edits, consider this approved for publication on both companies' sites. Alex also approved the logo placement Evelyn will share.

Appreciate the smooth process — happy to be a reference after the piece is live.
